message: ダンスガスンダ

name: Synn
message: 「There's a crowd over there... What's all the commotion?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bet it's just Flatty dining and dashing, or Big O setting a new record for stuffing his face.」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr! Boss and I are working hard! We literally just got back from a delivery--that's so mean!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Mean. Me, angry.」

name: Paqy
message: 「--is what Master Synn said!」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't say that!」

name: Synn
message: 「There it is again. Now they're even clapping.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm... hmm? It really sounds lively. Wonder what it is?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Flatty doesn't even have to bother jumping up--Big O can peek right over from here, can't ya?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me, big, so can see.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Sparkly, dancing, Lolotte.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」
There's less than a month left until Christmas. Is Lolotte promoting the Holy Night Festival?
I push my way through the crowd and head toward the center of the commotion.

name: Synn
message: 「Hup... and there!」
Slipping past people's legs, I somehow manage to reach the spot.

name: Synn
message: 「There she is! Lorot--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, hold hands nice and tight so we don't drift apart.」

name: Young Girl
message: 「L-Like this? Squee~ze...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Together, we go shuff-shuffle with our feet, and then hop-hoppity♪」

name: Young Girl
message: 「S-So in other words, it's a dynamic dance.」
Just as Eauderourke said, Lolotte is dancing.
However, it doesn't seem to be Student Council PR--Lolotte isn't paying any mind to the people around her.
Maybe she's just having so much fun with her friend that they naturally held hands, and it turned into a dance?
Whoa, her wings are out.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so thrilled we get to dance together again. I'm never letting go this time\s07」

name: Young Girl
message: 「L-Lolotte...! Y-Your wings, your wings!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, let's hop around all sparkly and twirly」

name: Young Girl
message: 「N-No, that's not it...!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo, that looks fun! Let me join in too♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, come on, let's all three hold hands」

name: Sally
message: 「Spin, spin, twirl~\s07 Not that it matters, Lorochi, but your wings are showing? Nyah-nyah, totally busted as an angel」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I-I-I'm not an angeeeel」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Ho...! Well then, once more... twiiiirl, twirl-twirl♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh-heh-heh... an angel dancing with demons. Kinda a historic moment right here」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek, spin-spin-spin-spin, my head's gonna spiiin~」
And so, the three of them wrapped up their dance.

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's going to be a dance party at the Holy Night Festival, so this settles what my dance will be」

name: Young Girl
message: 「It was worth the two of us coming up with it together. Thank you as well, Sally-san」

name: Sally
message: 「Dizzy-dizzy~, spin-spin-spin~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so that was an interpretive dance?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, you were watching too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ahem, how was it! I was expressing bonito flakes dancing on top of sizzling hot okonomiyaki」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Eh...? I-Is that what it was...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I seee~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to Synn-sama to actually buy that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So exciting♪ It might even be a costume dance party. If it is, let's all dress up as okonomiyaki together with you, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, sounds good」

name: Young Girl
message: 「A-Are you sure about that...?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, want to see, more dancing」

name: Sally
message: 「Twirl-twirl, dizzy-dizzy... Oyabin, tag in... thud」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Dance, like, leave to me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Mr. Sumo Wrestler, the Unryu-style ring-entering ceremony has nothing to do with Christmas, you know?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「E-Eeeek! A-A wall of meat is charging right at me……! H-H-H-Help meeee!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee, our dance put everyone in such a happy mood. All right, Mr. President, Mr. Panda, passing the baton to you」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Prez, Paqy, dance」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaah!?」
